controls.title: Consent mechanism exists
controls.description: A consent mechanism must be available for visitors where required.
controls.rationale: Visitors must be able to grant or withhold consent for nonessential processing.
controls.recommended_value: Consent banner or equivalent CMP is present and functional.

controls.title: Nonessential scripts are blocked before consent
controls.description: Nonessential scripts and tags must not execute before the visitor grants the required consent.
controls.rationale: Loading trackers before consent can process personal data without a lawful basis.
controls.recommended_value: No nonessential scripts execute before consent.

controls.title: Analytics consent defaults to denied
controls.description: Analytics consent must default to denied where a consent mechanism is in use.
controls.rationale: Analytics should be opt-in rather than enabled by default.
controls.recommended_value: analytics_storage defaults to denied.

controls.title: Marketing consent defaults to denied
controls.description: Marketing and advertising consent must default to denied.
controls.rationale: Advertising signals should not be enabled before explicit consent.
controls.recommended_value: Marketing and advertising categories default to denied.

controls.title: Consent can be withdrawn
controls.description: Visitors must be able to withdraw or change consent after it was granted.
controls.rationale: Consent must be as easy to withdraw as it is to give.
controls.recommended_value: Privacy settings can be reopened and consent withdrawn.

controls.title: Consent preferences are persisted
controls.description: Visitor consent choices must persist across page loads for a reasonable period.
controls.rationale: Repeated consent prompts create poor UX and may undermine trust.
controls.recommended_value: Consent choices are stored client-side without unnecessary identifiers.

controls.title: Consent version is recorded
controls.description: The active consent policy version must be recorded with visitor choices.
controls.rationale: Policy changes require traceability of which version applied.
controls.recommended_value: Consent version is stored with visitor preferences.

controls.title: Consent categories are clearly separated
controls.description: Necessary, analytics, marketing, and external media consent must be separable.
controls.rationale: Bundled consent prevents granular visitor choice.
controls.recommended_value: Consent categories are distinct and independently selectable.

controls.title: Google Analytics does not execute before permitted consent
controls.description: GA4 must not load or send measurement requests before analytics consent is granted.
controls.rationale: Analytics tags must not fire before lawful consent where required.
controls.recommended_value: No GA requests or _ga cookie before analytics consent.

controls.title: Google Tag Manager is appropriately consent-gated
controls.description: GTM must initialize consent state before analytics or marketing tags fire where required.
controls.rationale: GTM can load multiple tags; consent must gate applicable tags.
controls.recommended_value: Consent Mode initializes before applicable GTM tags fire.

controls.title: Unknown tracking scripts are detected
controls.description: Unrecognized third-party tracking scripts must be surfaced for administrator review.
controls.rationale: Unknown trackers cannot be governed without discovery.
controls.recommended_value: All external tracking scripts are identified or flagged for review.

controls.title: Third-party cookies are inventoried
controls.description: Third-party cookies set by the site should be inventoried for review.
controls.rationale: Cookie visibility supports lawful processing and transparency.
controls.recommended_value: Third-party cookies are listed without storing sensitive values.

controls.title: Advertising tracking is disabled by default
controls.description: Advertising and marketing tags must remain disabled until explicit consent.
controls.rationale: Advertising signals should not run by default.
controls.recommended_value: ad_storage, ad_user_data, and ad_personalization default to denied.

controls.title: Consent Mode v2 is configured
controls.description: Google Consent Mode v2 must be configured when Google Analytics or Ads tags are present.
controls.rationale: Consent Mode communicates consent state to Google tags.
controls.recommended_value: Consent Mode v2 is active with appropriate defaults.

controls.title: analytics_storage defaults to denied
controls.description: The analytics_storage consent type must default to denied.
controls.rationale: Analytics storage requires explicit consent where applicable.
controls.recommended_value: analytics_storage=denied before consent.

controls.title: ad_storage defaults to denied
controls.description: The ad_storage consent type must default to denied.
controls.rationale: Advertising cookies require explicit consent.
controls.recommended_value: ad_storage=denied before consent.

controls.title: ad_user_data defaults to denied
controls.description: The ad_user_data consent type must default to denied.
controls.rationale: Sending user data for ads requires explicit consent under Consent Mode v2.
controls.recommended_value: ad_user_data=denied before consent.

controls.title: ad_personalization defaults to denied
controls.description: The ad_personalization consent type must default to denied.
controls.rationale: Ad personalization requires explicit consent under Consent Mode v2.
controls.recommended_value: ad_personalization=denied before consent.

controls.title: GA4 data retention uses recommended settings
controls.description: GA4 event data retention should be reviewed against recommended practice.
controls.rationale: Excessive retention increases privacy risk.
controls.recommended_value: 14 months or less unless a documented reason exists.
controls.manual_review_instructions: Review GA4 Admin → Data retention and document the chosen period.

controls.title: Google Signals configuration reviewed
controls.description: Google Signals settings should be reviewed for cross-device tracking impact.
controls.rationale: Signals can combine data across devices and sessions.
controls.manual_review_instructions: Review Google Signals status in GA4 Admin and document the decision.

controls.title: Google Ads links reviewed
controls.description: Links between GA4 and Google Ads should be reviewed.
controls.rationale: Ads linking can expand data sharing beyond analytics.
controls.manual_review_instructions: Review Google Ads account links and document whether they are required.

controls.title: No obvious PII sent to GA
controls.description: Obvious personally identifiable information must not be sent to Google Analytics.
controls.rationale: Analytics should not process unnecessary personal data.
controls.recommended_value: No email addresses, names, or tokens in GA payloads.

controls.title: Duplicate GA implementations not detected
controls.description: Multiple concurrent GA4 implementations can cause duplicate measurement.
controls.rationale: Duplicate tags inflate data and may bypass consent gating.
controls.recommended_value: A single GA4 implementation is active.

controls.title: YouTube embeds are privacy-gated
controls.description: YouTube embeds must not load before External Media consent where gating is enabled.
controls.rationale: YouTube can set cookies and receive viewing data on load.
controls.recommended_value: YouTube iframes are blocked until External Media consent.

controls.title: Third-party embeds are inventoried
controls.description: Third-party iframe embeds should be inventoried for review.
controls.rationale: Embedded content can transfer data to third parties.
controls.recommended_value: Known third-party embeds are listed for review.

controls.title: Forms collecting personal data are inventoried
controls.description: Forms that collect personal data should be identified.
controls.rationale: Data collection points must be visible for privacy governance.
controls.recommended_value: All personal-data forms are listed.

controls.title: Marketing consent is not bundled with necessary processing
controls.description: Marketing consent should be separate from consent required to submit a form.
controls.rationale: Bundled consent undermines freely given consent for marketing.
controls.manual_review_instructions: Review form consent checkboxes and separate marketing opt-in where applicable.

controls.title: Privacy notice capability exists
controls.description: Forms collecting personal data should link to or include a privacy notice.
controls.rationale: Visitors must be informed about data use at collection time.
controls.manual_review_instructions: Confirm forms reference the site privacy policy or an equivalent notice.

controls.title: Sensitive fields are flagged
controls.description: Sensitive or high-risk form fields should be flagged for review.
controls.rationale: Sensitive categories may require additional safeguards.
controls.recommended_value: Sensitive free-text and special-category fields are identified.

controls.title: Retention configuration is reviewed
controls.description: Form entry retention settings should be reviewed where supported.
controls.rationale: Data should not be kept longer than necessary.
controls.manual_review_instructions: Review retention settings in supported form plugins and document periods.

controls.title: Privacy Policy page exists and is configured
controls.description: WordPress must have a published Privacy Policy page assigned.
controls.rationale: Visitors need access to privacy information.
controls.recommended_value: A published Privacy Policy page is assigned under Settings → Privacy.

controls.title: Personal data export functionality is available
controls.description: WordPress personal data export tools must be available.
controls.rationale: Data subjects may request a copy of their personal data.
controls.recommended_value: Personal data export functionality is available.

controls.title: Personal data erasure functionality is available
controls.description: WordPress personal data erasure tools must be available.
controls.rationale: Data subjects may request deletion of their personal data.
controls.recommended_value: Personal data erasure functionality is available.

controls.title: User registration configuration is reviewed
controls.description: Open registration and related privacy settings should be reviewed.
controls.rationale: Registration creates new personal data processing.
controls.recommended_value: User registration configuration reviewed and justified.

controls.title: Comment and privacy behavior reviewed
controls.description: Comment settings and associated data collection should be reviewed.
controls.rationale: Comments can collect and publish personal data.
controls.manual_review_instructions: Review discussion settings, comment cookies, and gravatar usage.

controls.title: REST endpoints do not unnecessarily expose personal information
controls.description: WordPress REST API exposure of personal data should be reviewed.
controls.rationale: Public endpoints can leak user or author information.
controls.recommended_value: REST endpoints do not unnecessarily expose personal information.

controls.title: Known PII query parameters are excluded from analytics
controls.description: Sensitive URL query parameters must be stripped before analytics page-location data is sent.
controls.rationale: URL parameters can contain emails, names, and tokens.
controls.recommended_value: Configured sensitive query parameters are excluded from analytics.

controls.title: Authentication tokens are excluded from analytics
controls.description: Tokens and session identifiers must not be sent to analytics providers.
controls.rationale: Tokens in analytics payloads create security and privacy risk.
controls.recommended_value: token, authorization, access_token, session, and jwt parameters are excluded.

controls.title: Known sensitive URL parameters are identified
controls.description: The site should identify sensitive query parameters present in URLs.
controls.rationale: Discovery is required before exclusion can be verified.
controls.recommended_value: Sensitive URL parameters are inventoried without logging values.

controls.title: Email addresses are not used as GA User-ID
controls.description: Email addresses must not be used as Google Analytics User-ID.
controls.rationale: Direct identifiers should not be sent to analytics.
controls.recommended_value: GA User-ID does not contain email addresses.

controls.title: Analytics retention reviewed
controls.description: Analytics data retention periods should be reviewed.
controls.rationale: Retention should be limited to what is necessary.
controls.recommended_value: 14 months or less unless documented otherwise.
controls.manual_review_instructions: Review GA4 retention settings and document the chosen period.

controls.title: Form-entry retention reviewed
controls.description: Form entry retention should be reviewed where supported.
controls.rationale: Form data should not be retained indefinitely.
controls.manual_review_instructions: Review supported form plugin retention settings.

controls.title: Plugin consent and evidence retention policy defined
controls.description: ComplyOps consent and evidence retention should be configured.
controls.rationale: The compliance tool must not retain data longer than necessary.
controls.recommended_value: Evidence retention period is configured and documented.

controls.title: Site is served over HTTPS
controls.description: The WordPress site should be configured to use HTTPS.
controls.rationale: Transport encryption protects personal data in transit.
controls.recommended_value: Site URL and Home URL use HTTPS.

controls.title: WordPress core version is supported
controls.description: WordPress core should meet the supported minimum version.
controls.rationale: Unsupported core versions may lack security fixes.
controls.recommended_value: WordPress 6.6 or newer.

controls.title: Plugin update posture reviewed
controls.description: Plugins with data-protection impact should be reasonably current.
controls.rationale: Outdated plugins can introduce vulnerabilities affecting personal data.
controls.recommended_value: Plugins affecting privacy or security are kept updated.

controls.title: User privilege configuration reviewed
controls.description: Administrative accounts and privileges should follow least-privilege practices.
controls.rationale: Excessive privileges increase risk of unauthorized data access.
controls.manual_review_instructions: Review administrator accounts, roles, and shared credentials.

controls.title: Accept and reject are equally prominent
controls.description: Accept and reject buttons must require comparable effort.
controls.rationale: Consent must not be obtained through dark patterns.

controls.title: Withdrawal stops future processing
controls.description: Changing or withdrawing consent must stop future nonessential processing.
controls.rationale: Withdrawal must be effective, not cosmetic.

controls.title: Consent records are complete
controls.description: Consent records must include timestamp, version, categories and source.
controls.rationale: Demonstrating valid consent requires traceability.

controls.title: Plugin export and erasure coverage
controls.description: Export and erasure must cover supported plugin data, not only WordPress core.
controls.rationale: Data subject rights must reach plugin-held data.

controls.title: Rights request mechanisms are discoverable
controls.description: Correction, restriction and objection routes must be discoverable.
controls.rationale: Data subjects must know how to exercise rights.

controls.title: Processing purposes documented
controls.description: Processing purposes and lawful basis must be documented for each collection point.
controls.rationale: Lawful basis must be established before processing.
controls.manual_review_instructions: Document lawful basis and purpose for each collection point.

controls.title: Processor inventory current
controls.description: Processor inventory and DPAs must be current.
controls.rationale: Article 28 requires appropriate processor agreements.
controls.manual_review_instructions: Maintain processor inventory and executed DPAs.

controls.title: International transfers documented
controls.description: International transfer mechanisms must be documented where applicable.
controls.rationale: Cross-border transfers require appropriate safeguards.
controls.manual_review_instructions: Document transfer mechanisms such as SCCs or adequacy decisions.

controls.title: DPIA for high-risk processing
controls.description: Data protection impact assessments must exist for high-risk processing.
controls.rationale: Article 35 requires DPIAs for likely high-risk processing.
controls.manual_review_instructions: Complete DPIA where high-risk processing is identified.

controls.title: Breach response procedure
controls.description: Breach-response procedure and 72-hour escalation workflow must be documented.
controls.rationale: Articles 33-34 require breach assessment and notification.
controls.manual_review_instructions: Document breach response, escalation, and notification workflow.

controls.title: Retention jobs enforce expiry
controls.description: Retention jobs must remove or anonymize expired form, consent and evidence records.
controls.rationale: Storage limitation requires operational enforcement.

controls.title: Personal data absent from leakage vectors
controls.description: Personal information must be absent from URLs, analytics, logs and error messages.
controls.rationale: Article 32 requires appropriate security of processing.

label: GDPR Technical Readiness
disclaimer: GDPR technical readiness only; not legal compliance or a certification.
